newsitem.title: USA: Alabama sees $30 million surplus for FY 1996.
newsitem.headline: Alabama sees $30 million surplus for FY 1996.

text.p: Alabama will end fiscal 1996 with a surplus of $30 million to $40 million in its general fund, Legislative Fiscal Office Director Joyce Bigbee said Friday.
"We had higher than expected oil and gas severance taxes and higher corporation tax receipts than projected," Bigbee said.
The money stays in the general fund and can be allocated during fiscal 1997, which begins Oct 1, Bigbee said.
The state's Education Trust Fund will have a $25 million surplus, she said. That surplus was expected and has already been allocated for education projects, Bigbee
